entries.zh: 天景；天上繁星密布的景象（如天堂一般）
entries.en: the aspect of the sky; the starry heavens (likened to paradise)
entries.notes: L 栏「Z.」为缩写、「estrellados」语法不全，义据 H 天景／M thi-keng 及天堂繁星语境推定。

entries.en: to pair up, to mate; to join together
to be a counterpart; to face or correspond to each other

entries.zh: 成双、配成一对（原稿 H 栏作「送」，与义不合，据音当为「雙」）
entries.en: to form a pair, to double up (H reads 送 'to send', which does not fit; by sound prob. 雙 'double')
entries.notes: H 送 与 parearse（配对）义不合；M sāng 加平声调号指向 雙，据音义校正，仍存疑。

entries.zh: 匹配、婚配（如夫妻般成对）
entries.en: to be matched, to pair as spouses
to be paired, to come in pairs (of things)
entries.notes: T99 污损；M quy 与 對 常读不合，然 H 成對 与西语义明。

entries.en: to be alike, to resemble each other (of two things)
entries.notes: R 栏「duch cara」不能读作官话，M 首节 lü 亦不合 同 常读；义据 H 同 与西语定。

entries.en: to be similar, to resemble; to be like
entries.notes: M 第二式 hin chiò 疑为 好像(hó-chhiūnn)，T99 污损。

entries.zh: 宛如、仿佛（在某方面相似）
entries.en: to be as if, to be like; to resemble in some way

entries.zh: 照（…看来）、依…判断——「在我看来」
entries.en: to seem to me (that); in my view, according to
entries.notes: L 末尾「que[残]」残缺，义据「parecerme que」补足。

entries.zh: 以为、觉得（认为某事如此）
entries.en: to think, to be of the opinion (that it is so)
entries.notes: H 惕 有[疑]且 T99；M sūg（suk）与 惕 常读不合，唯西语「parecerle qu'es」义明。

entries.zh: 思量、估量；认为（西语注「piensa que」即「以为」）
entries.en: to reckon, to consider; to think (that)

entries.zh: 才貌过人（才学容貌胜过他人）
entries.en: to surpass others in looks and talent
entries.notes: L 栏「la bio」疑为「el brío」，全句残乱；据 H 才貌過人 定。

entries.zh: 出头、显露（显出本相或身份）
entries.en: to come to the fore, to show forth (one's condition)
entries.notes: L「condió」为 condición 缩写；H 出頭 与「显现」义相合但非直译。
H 首 与 M cúa 不合，疑原稿为 秀/看；据「parecer bien」定「好看」。

entries.zh: 露面、抛头露面；门面（外表）
entries.en: to show one's face, to appear openly; outward appearance, façade

entries.zh: 照原（依本来面目、按本性显现）
entries.en: to appear as one naturally is; according to one's original nature
to be exactly alike, to be the very image of
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:障/鄣]，M chiō̃ chīn chiō 当作 像親像（酷似）；L「nima, nimenos」即 ni más ni menos。
